title: Fix Russian dictionary variant selection being ignored
description:
## Problem
When a user selects "strict" Russian dictionary variant, the game still accepts words from the full dictionary. The variant selection UI is misleading.

- gameController.ts:372 explicitly voids the variant: void meta?.russianDictionaryVariant
- buildWordChecker() always delegates to hasWord() which checks the full dictionary first
- dictionaryController.ts:90-114 has a hasWordWithVariant() method that WOULD implement this correctly, but it is never called

## Files
- src/controllers/gameController.ts:370-377 (buildWordChecker)
- src/controllers/dictionaryController.ts:90-114 (unused hasWordWithVariant)
- src/dictionary/dictionaryService.ts:305 (hasWord always checks full first)

## Fix
Wire buildWordChecker() to use hasWordWithVariant() from dictionaryController, passing the meta.russianDictionaryVariant. When variant is 'strict', only check against the strict dictionary (nominative+plural nouns, base form others).

## Verification
- Start a Russian game with 'strict' variant
- Try playing an inflected word form that exists in full dict but not strict
- Verify it is rejected
- Switch to 'full' variant, verify it is accepted

title: Add render batching to prevent excessive DOM updates
description:
## Problem
renderAll() rebuilds the entire board (225 cells as HTML string via innerHTML), rack, scores, and stats on every state change. It is called from many places and can cascade (e.g., updateValidation triggers renderAll up to 3 times).

On low-end mobile devices (the target platform), this causes noticeable lag during rapid interactions.

## Files
- src/ui/uiRenderer.ts:229-306 (renderBoard — full innerHTML rebuild)
- src/main.ts:109-125 (renderAll)
- Called from: gameController, messageHandler, sessionManager, eventSetup

## Fix Options (pick one)
1. **requestAnimationFrame debounce**: Wrap renderAll in rAF so multiple calls within one frame are batched into a single render
2. **Dirty-flag system**: Mark which parts changed (board/rack/scores/stats) and only re-render dirty parts
3. **Incremental board updates**: Maintain cell element references and only update changed cells (bigger change but best perf)

Option 1 is the lowest-effort highest-impact improvement. Option 3 is ideal for board specifically.

## Verification
- Add performance marks around renderAll, measure paint time on mobile
- Rapid tile placement should feel responsive
- No visual glitches or stale state

title: Add tests for messageHandler, sessionManager, eventSetup
description:
## Problem
The three most important orchestration modules have zero test coverage:
- src/controllers/messageHandler.ts (handles all P2P actions)
- src/controllers/sessionManager.ts (game start/resume/join)
- src/ui/eventSetup.ts (UI event wiring)

The ACTION_MOVE bug (scrabble-de9) exists because these modules are untested.

## Scope
Priority order:
1. messageHandler — test each message type (SYNC_STATE, ACTION_MOVE, ACTION_PASS, ACTION_EXCHANGE, DRAFT_PLACEMENTS, PLAYER_READY, ACTION_REMATCH_REQUEST, REQUEST_SYNC)
2. sessionManager — test startSession, resumeSession, joinSession
3. eventSetup — test key event handlers (submit move, pass, exchange)

Use mocked App/controllers. Focus on:
- Correct function calls and argument passing
- State mutations (meta, labels)
- Error/edge cases (not host, no game state, invalid messages)

## Verification
- npm test passes
- New test files have meaningful assertions (not just smoke tests)
notes:
## Progress (session 2026-02-19)

### Fixed this session
- Build errors in all 3 test files: wrong GameEndReason enum values ('empty_rack'→'no_moves_bag_empty', 'consecutive_passes'→'four_passes')
- vi.fn() type mismatch in messageHandler.test.ts line 259 (restartForRematch param)
- eslint no-explicit-any in eventSetup.test.ts line 549 (as any → as unknown as typeof)
- Added testTimeout: 5000 to vite.config.ts (was missing entirely)

### Current status
- **messageHandler.test.ts**: BUILD OK, 51 tests PASS (verified)
- **sessionManager.test.ts**: BUILD OK, 40 tests PASS (verified)
- **eventSetup.test.ts**: BUILD OK, but HANGS at runtime — never completes

### Root cause of eventSetup hang (not yet fixed)
setupEvents() attaches window.addEventListener('online'/'offline') on jsdom global window. Each beforeEach calls setupEvents() again stacking listeners without cleanup. Some async click handlers (confirmMoveBtn, passBtn, exchangeBtn) chain multiple awaits (ensureLanguage → submitMove → finalizeGameEnd). If any mock in the chain doesn't resolve, vi.waitFor() polls indefinitely.

### TODO to fix eventSetup.test.ts
1. Add afterEach that removes window event listeners (or use AbortController)
2. Check that all mocks in async chains resolve (submitMove, submitPass, submitExchange, ensureLanguage, finalizeGameEnd)
3. Consider if vi.waitFor timeout in vitest 4.x defaults are sufficient or need explicit timeout per call
4. May need to restructure: instead of calling real setupEvents(), test event handlers individually

title: Validate incoming P2P messages before processing
description:
## Problem
messageHandler.ts:16 blindly casts incoming data: const msg = data as ActionMessage
No validation of message shape, type field, or payload fields. Also, decodeSDP() in p2p.ts:117-119 does JSON.parse(atob(data)) with no try/catch.

In a P2P context, incoming data is untrusted. Malformed messages could crash the app or cause desync.

## Files
- src/controllers/messageHandler.ts:16 (unsafe cast)
- src/network/p2p.ts:117-119 (decodeSDP no validation)

## Fix
1. Create isActionMessage(data: unknown): data is ActionMessage type guard
2. Validate required fields exist and have correct types before processing
3. Wrap decodeSDP in try/catch with user-friendly error message
4. Log and ignore invalid messages rather than crashing

## Verification
- Send a malformed message via WebRTC data channel — app should not crash
- Send valid messages — normal flow unaffected
- Paste invalid text in QR/SDP field — get clear error, not crash

title: Sanitize innerHTML against XSS from peer-supplied data
description: ## Security Vulnerability Player labels come from peers via SYNC_STATE messages and are interpolated directly into HTML strings via innerHTML. A malicious peer could set their name to and execute JavaScript on the other player's device. ## Affected Files - src/ui/uiRenderer.ts:354-359 (renderScores — labels in HTML) - src/ui/uiRenderer.ts:393-401 (renderStats — labels in history) - src/controllers/gameOver.ts:118,128-135 (game-over scores/stats) - src/ui/blankTileSelector.ts:40 (innerHTML for dialog, but uses hardcoded content — safe) ## Fix Approach 1. Create an escapeHtml(str) utility or use textContent/createTextNode 2. Apply escaping to ALL interpolated values from external sources (labels, words, scores) 3. Consider switching to DOM element creation for dynamic content 4. Add a test that verifies HTML special chars in player names are escaped ## Verification - Set player name to or - Verify it renders as text, not executed HTML

title: Fix service worker caching non-existent dictionary files
description:
## Problem
public/sw.js CORE_ASSETS includes dicts/en-basic.txt and dicts/ru-basic.txt, but dictionaries are now compressed JSON fetched from the GitHub assets branch. These .txt files likely 404 on the deployed server.

cache.addAll() fails entirely if ANY URL returns non-200, which breaks the entire service worker installation and all offline support.

Additionally, vite.config.ts:48 has a leading space in the baseUrl string that makes dictionary download URLs invalid in dev mode.

## Files
- public/sw.js:3-11 (CORE_ASSETS array)
- vite.config.ts:48 (leading space in baseUrl)

## Fix
1. Remove dicts/en-basic.txt and dicts/ru-basic.txt from CORE_ASSETS
2. Either pre-cache the compressed JSON URLs or skip dictionary pre-caching entirely (dictionaries are fetched on demand and stored in IndexedDB)
3. Fix the leading space in vite.config.ts:48
4. Consider adding individual cache.put with error handling instead of cache.addAll for optional assets

## Verification
- Deploy to GitHub Pages
- Open DevTools > Application > Service Workers — verify SW installs successfully
- Check Cache Storage — verify no failed entries
- Go offline — verify the app shell loads

title: Fix ACTION_MOVE handler dropping remote placements
description:
## Bug Description
When a client sends an ACTION_MOVE message in P2P multiplayer, the host's messageHandler.ts:127-136 calls gameController.submitMove() which uses this.placements (the HOST's local placements, which are empty). The msg.placements from the remote player are never used.

submitMove() returns false at line 218 (this.placements.length === 0), silently dropping the client's move.

## Files
- src/controllers/messageHandler.ts:127-136 (ACTION_MOVE handler)
- src/controllers/gameController.ts:214-254 (submitMove)
- src/ui/eventSetup.ts:85-91 (client sends placements)

## Fix Approach
Add a method like gameController.submitRemoteMove(placements, playerId, wordChecker) that:
1. Sets the placements from the message
2. Uses the remote player's ID (not meta.localPlayerId)
3. Calls game.placeMove with the correct parameters
4. Handles game-end logic

## Verification
- Start a P2P game between two browser tabs
- Have the client (non-host) place tiles and submit a move
- Verify the move is applied on both sides

title: Extract duplicated dictionary processing logic
description:
## Problem
The pattern of "iterate DictionaryEntry[], build wordSet + entryMap, populate memoryCache" is repeated 4 times:
- ensureDictionary() ~lines 117-132
- downloadDictionaryStrict() ~lines 216-228
- downloadDictionary() ~lines 276-295
- ensureDictionaryStrict() ~lines 394-409

60+ lines of duplicated logic in src/dictionary/dictionaryService.ts.

## Fix
Extract a helper function:
processDictionaryEntries(key: DictionaryKey, entries: DictionaryEntry[]): { wordSet: Set<string>; entryMap: Map<string, DictionaryEntry> }

Call it from all 4 locations. This also makes it easier to add new entry types or processing logic in the future.

## Verification
- npm test passes
- Dictionary loading works for English and both Russian variants
- Word lookup returns correct results
close_reason: All Wave 2A tasks verified: message validation, dict dedup, render batching, Russian variant fix

title: Clean up dead code and stale module-level state
description:
## Items
1. **Dead export**: uiRenderer.ts exports applyActionButtonsState() which is never imported — main.ts has its own inline version. Remove the unused export or consolidate.
2. **Stale minLength state**: dictionaryService.ts has module-level minLength, getMinWordLength(), setMinWordLength() that no longer affect word validation (moved to game engine). Remove them.
3. **Module-level labels**: uiRenderer.ts has module-level mutable labels set via setLabels(). Functions already accept labels as params — remove the module state.
4. **Unnecessary async**: gameController.ts submitPass() and submitExchange() are declared async but contain no await.
5. **Inline import() types**: src/types.ts uses inline import() references to src/core/types.ts instead of standard import type statements.

## Verification
- npm run build succeeds with no errors
- npm test passes
- npm run lint passes
